scope: Independent read-only review of supplied original sources and observed three-model failures. Review preceded the final patch and is not a certification of the patched tree.
accepted: Distinct observation cutoff and valuation deadline
One-current-reply wording without numbered dialogue labels
Exclusive HOLD/allocation feedback; all valid correction choices
Explicit current CASH fraction and consistent allocation units
Actionable package route and RAG shortcut contracts
Reject abandoned failures and earlier accepted orders shadowed by later turns
Recompute research/delivery/library-use observations from original records
Carry unverified historical-availability labels into scores and aggregates
additional_source_finding: Package RAG call_template advertised a direct tool name unavailable in the study. v9 now renders that template through call_library_tool with unchanged inner arguments.
not_adopted: Stopping at the first complete JSON could discard a competing instruction; strict whole-response validation remains.
No new decoding constraint, token budget, default portfolio or forced library use.
checked_assumption: RAG search uses available_at <= as_of, inclusive; same-day regression added.
outstanding: Verified historical vintages cannot be manufactured from retrospective backfills.
Per-model training exposure to the development market path is not verified.
A preflight pass does not prove full-cycle reliability, profitability, or all capabilities used.
